adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the new fallback path inside the `if (credentialId)` branch will query `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` when the credential is not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, then passes that credential into `getCalendar()` and calls `calendar?.deleteEvent(...)`. This is a diff-introduced change from the prior behavior (which only used `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`) and it lacks any ownership/tenant scoping (e.g., `userId`/`teamId` checks). If a booking reference contains a credentialId not belonging to the booking’s user, this code would still load and use it to authenticate calendar operations, creating an IDOR-style security risk.
